name: Barbell Feet-Elevated Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back facing a sturdy box, plant both heels firmly on top of the box, and balance a barbell across your hip creases.
Hold the bar steady with both hands, tuck your ribs down, and brace your abs.
Drive through your heels to raise your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes briefly at the top, then lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
tips: Finish by squeezing your glutes tightly without arching your lower back past neutral.
Place a folded towel beneath the barbell if the bar feels uncomfortable across your hips.
